purpose: Combine an immutable classifier verdict with conservative exact-text evidence and an optional human-certified compact VLM fact, producing short reviewer-facing Russian prose without changing score or prediction.

immutable_anchor.evidence_verdict_disagreement_action: emit review conflict or retain deterministic fallback; never override

priority: human-certified source-bound compact visual fact supporting the frozen verdict
reviewer_safe_rationale_v1 exact-text evidence supporting the frozen verdict

moderator_output.exact_text_policy: Quoted text must be a validated literal span of name or description; no paraphrase may replace it.
moderator_output.image_policy: An image observation is quoted only from the exact human-accepted compact output bound to the current source and selected image prefix.
moderator_output.conflict_policy: A conflict line is a request for manual review and is never presented as support for the frozen verdict.

required_identity: id and category equal the current card
input_image_ids is the exact non-empty prefix of current source images
required_generation: the 13-line output passes compact_vlm_rationale strict parsing against only the selected image prefix

visual_claim_guard.reason: A view can positively identify a visible fact but visual non-observation cannot prove that an item or content is absent from the sold product.

bad_assessor_noise_policy.direct_marking_or_explicit_exclusion_dis: retain anchor, avoid a categorical supporting rationale, quote the opposing exact fact under КОНФЛИКТ, and request manual review

fallbacks.invalid_or_unreviewed_vlm: use reviewer_safe_rationale_v1 and retain machine-readable rejection issues
fallbacks.over_length_evidence: do not truncate a meaning-bearing claim; use the safe text result or fallback
fallbacks.no_safe_evidence: state that a safe grounded basis is unavailable and preserve the classifier verdict
